svg.title: pos-rope-spectrum
svg.desc: RoPE pair i rotates by theta_i = b^(-2i/d_h) per token. Left: four pairs of Llama 3 (b = 500K, d_h = 128) over 1,000 tokens: pair 0 turns 159 times, pair 21 turns 2.1 times, pair 42 turns 10 degrees, pair 63 turns 0.14 degrees. Right: wavelength of all 64 pairs for b = 10K, 500K and 10M on a log axis with 8K and 128K context lines; the slowest pair spans 54K, 2.6M and 49M tokens. Bottom: Gemma 3 and DeepSeek-V4 use a small base in local layers and a large base in global layers.
